description:
FOUND s543w (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, base 749eaf0e = CODE 6a1301ed) while measuring #650's rebuild, and FIXED in the same batch.

THE SHAPE (neutral, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL on main):

    my @a = (1); my $n = 1; sub f { 1 }
    print "a\n" if $a[0] < 2*$n and 3 > 1;
    print "b\n" if f() < 2*$n and 3 > 1;
    print "c\n" if time < 2**40 and 1 > 0;

    perl: a b c
    PCL : PCL: statement dropped ... Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [... Token::QuoteLike::Readline<<2*$nand3>> ...]

    The same after `$h{k}`, `$o->size`, `K` (use constant), `@{$r}`, `scalar(@a)`.  `X < 5 and 1 > 0` (no
    `*`) and `X < 2*$n && 3 > 1` (`&&` stops the scan) were right.

CAUSE: `Pl::PExpr::_fix_ppi_glob_after_block` rebuilt any `<` ... `>` run that held a glob metacharacter
(`*`) as ONE Readline unless the token before the `<` was a Symbol / Number / Quote -- a Structure (a
subscript, a call's list, a dereference block), a method name, a builtin without an operand and a declared
term all let it through, and the token contents were joined without the whitespace.

FIX (s543w, PCL side of #650): the rebuild fires only where only a DECLARATION says a term is expected --
right after a user's word that is not after `->`, not a PPI keyword (unless spelled like an operator /
quote-like operator) and not a declared nullary term (`_is_zero_arg_func`), or at the start of the run --
and it takes the SOURCE text between the brackets (`_angle_source_text`).  Everywhere else PCL's PPI has
decided (groups AH, BJ, BK).  Guard: Pl/t/readline-ternary-01.t "negative: `X < 2*$n and 3 > 1` compares
after a subscript, a call and time" (fails on main).

=== DONE (s543w) ===  The fire count of the rebuild over 2,703 files (wide list + Rosetta + shapes): base
9 files / 24 fires (5 of them the Rosetta `use List::Util <...>` readlines, #650) -> tree: see the s543w
session-log; no fire ever came from the reverse shape.


=== CLOSED (the reviewing session, 2026-11-28) === merged as MAIN-READY-116 ac66f5b4 (s543w, v2-16900; PPI branch pcl = eca93377, groups BJ..BM); the full gate on merged main 380 files / 12,590 rows PASS and ROSETTA 569 of 650 with buckets 0 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/gate-ac66f5b4.log); the review probes ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1128/rw (five files, every row = perl: the comparisons that must stay comparisons first); no live baseline row is keyed on this task.
frequency_reason: an ordinary compound condition (`$a[$i] < 2*$n and $j > 0`); found by a probe, no program of the four populations or the Rosetta corpus holds it (0 fires of the rebuild on such a shape over 2,703 files) -- written ordinary because nothing about the spelling is unusual
subject: DROP: a comparison `X < ...*... and Y > ...` after a subscript, a call, a method name, `time` or a declared constant was REBUILT AS A GLOB by PExpr::_fix_ppi_glob_after_block and the statement dropped (FIXED s543w)
triage_reason: numeric comparisons are core (docs/supported-subset.md): a less-than must stay a less-than
